_note: Defined key votes for P2 Incumbent Alignment scoring.
_rationale: Votes selected for direct relevance to labor organizing rights. All are floor votes with documented roll-call records. All four votes verified against official Senate.gov XML and clerk.house.gov before entry.

federal_votes.name: PRO Act
federal_votes.full_name: Protecting the Right to Organize Act
federal_votes._note: Passed House 225-206. Never received Senate floor vote. Roll Call 70 confirmed via clerk.house.gov and govtrack.us.

federal_votes.name: Sanders Minimum Wage Amendment
federal_votes.full_name: $15 Minimum Wage — Sanders Amdt. No. 972 to American Rescue Plan
federal_votes._note: Formal question: 'Motion to Waive All Applicable Budgetary Discipline Re: Sanders Amdt. No. 972.' Failed 42-58 (3/5 required). Voting Yea = supporting the $15 minimum wage = pro-labor. Roll Call 74 confirmed via senate.gov XML. Note: Sam initially provided Roll Call 48, which was the Lee health savings account amendment (Feb 5, 2021).

federal_votes.name: Abruzzo NLRB General Counsel Confirmation
federal_votes.full_name: Confirmation of Jennifer Ann Abruzzo as NLRB General Counsel
federal_votes._note: Confirmed 50-50 with VP Harris casting tie-breaking Yea. Strict party-line vote. Abruzzo is a pro-labor NLRB GC; voting to confirm = pro-labor. Roll Call 273 confirmed via senate.gov XML. Note: Sam initially provided Roll Call 232 (Lina Khan FTC cloture, 72-25) and Roll Call 190 (McReynolds USPS nomination, 59-38) — both wrong. Note: Sam said 50-48; actual was 50-50 + VP.

federal_votes.name: National Apprenticeship Act
federal_votes._note: Passed House. Expands registered apprenticeship programs with labor standards protections. Never received Senate floor vote. Roll Call 31 confirmed via clerk.house.gov and govtrack.us. Note: Sam initially provided HR7309 Roll Call 8 — HR7309 is WIOA reauthorization (Roll Call 193, May 2022); Roll Call 8 (Jan 2022) was H.Res.868 (NASA property leases rule).

_coverage_note: Federal votes only in this version. State legislative votes are Phase 4C. All four votes verified against official government XML sources before entry into config.
